message: 決意新たに

name: Synn
message: 「So, are we good with the plan we just talked about?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, indeed!」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, let's go!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Welcome back, milady.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「W-Welcome back...」

name: Synn
message: 「Amyrina... About Lolotte going back to Heaven...」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm really sorry!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm sorry, Amyrina. Even so, I simply... cannot return to Heaven.」

name: Synn
message: 「We want to do something about Re-Crea together. So...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So please, Amyrina...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「...It's alright. Somehow, I already... knew this would happen.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Amyrina...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Back when we were in Heaven, Lolotte used to be terribly selfish, you know.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「She refused to do anything unless she thought it would be fun.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「E-Amyrina! Why are you bringing that up all of a sudden?!\s01」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Even coming to the Human World was solely because she was desperate to find out what delicious food was.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「St-Stop it! In front of the President... You're making me sound like a total glutton! That's so embarrassing!\s01」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Ufufu. Still, it's the truth, isn't it?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「M-Maybe so, but...\s03 Th-That wasn't the only reason!\s01」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Compared to back then, Lolotte...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「You've grown so much you're practically unrecognizable.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Because the old you would surely never have thought of trying to do something about Re-Crea」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Th-That's not true at all」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Don't you think so, Jiiya?」

name: Riesling
message: 「...I must refrain from answering」

name: Lolotte
message: 「H-Hey, not you too, Jiiya!!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I'm just so happy. To see how wonderful and grown-up you've become, Lolotte」

name: Amyrina
message: 「That's why I too... must follow your example!!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I won't hesitate anymore like I used to. So I've made up my mind. That I will stay by your side, Lolotte」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Does that mean...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I simply cannot leave you behind and go back alone. I want to stand together with you... and confront Re-Crea」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh... Ooooh--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「E... Amyrina...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「We can't let something like Re-Crea defeat us. Let's do our best, Lolotte」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Emirinaaa!!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Wh-Whoa, whoa!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ugh... *sniff*... Thank you. Thank you so much... Amyrina...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Goodness... Honestly, Lolotte...」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you sure you're okay with this?」

name: Riesling
message: 「It is a decision my lady made for herself, so there is no issue」

name: Synn
message: 「By the way, Riesling. Did you notice that Lolotte and the others are angels?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Yes, naturally」

name: Synn
message: 「Right」

name: Riesling
message: 「Including the fact that you're no ordinary person」

name: Synn
message: 「Gulp」

name: Helena
message: 「I see, so that's how it is. Understood」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I don't know what I'll be able to do, but I'll assist you in every way I possibly can」

name: Synn
message: 「That's really reassuring. Thanks」

name: Amyrina
message: 「An angel's power. I only hope it can be of even a little help……」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Amyrina…… about that, actually. Another one of your kind is still hiding in the Human World」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Huh…… besides me?」

name: Synn
message: 「One of her kind means…… an angel?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-There's still another angel around……?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Let's go talk to them together on our next day off or something」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Yes, let's. I definitely think the more of us there are, the better」

name: Synn
message: 「I see…… I wonder who it could be?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You'll just have to wait until we meet to find out」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be someone I know?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Come on, tell us~~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Heehee, it's a secret. After all, isn't it way more fun if I keep it a mystery~?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's your reason?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now then, so that we can all enjoy a wonderful Holy Night Festival together…… let's give it our all!」

name: Everyone
message: 「Yeah!!」
